food_beverage_category.label: Food / beverage category
food_beverage_category.value: Plant-based beverages (oat, almond, soy, coconut), broths, teas, nutritional beverages and better-for-you snacks

brand_private_label_manufacturing.label: Brand / private-label manufacturing
brand_private_label_manufacturing.value: Customized manufacturing for top brands, retailers and foodservice providers, largely private-label and co-manufacturing; also some branded non-GMO products

shelf_life_storage_condition.label: Shelf life / storage condition
shelf_life_storage_condition.value: Largely shelf-stable aseptically packaged beverages and broths, plus dry ingredients and snacks

processing_technology.label: Processing technology
processing_technology.value: Aseptic processing and packaging of plant-based liquids (UHT), plus fruit snack and dry ingredient processing

temperature_controlled_logistics.label: Temperature-controlled logistics
temperature_controlled_logistics.value: Mostly ambient distribution of shelf-stable products across North America

customer_channel_sales_mix.label: Customer-channel sales mix
customer_channel_sales_mix.value: Retail, club, foodservice and e-commerce channels across North America, with retail the largest

input_food_safety_exposure.label: Input / food-safety exposure
input_food_safety_exposure.value: Organic and non-GMO certified ingredient sourcing (oats, almonds, soy, coconut); food safety and quality prioritized

notes: Shelf life, logistics and processing details come from general knowledge of the company, not the evidence.
